STEP 1 - Vessel type: flat plate (round). It has a rim band and a flat centre with no inner wall or shadow.

STEP 2 - Vessel size:
a) Type cue: the plate looks like a large round dinner plate, about 25-27 cm.
b) Reference cue: the pizza slice is roughly 11-12 cm along its outer crust, and the plate spans about 2.2 slice-lengths across the right side, which gives roughly 24-27 cm.
Reconciled width: about 26 cm. Area = 0.785 x 26² = 531 cm².

STEP 3 - Food items:
- Chicken (diced, cooked): covers about 18% of the plate, roughly 95 cm². Pile about 2 cm thick on average (chunks of about 1.5-2 cm, about one layer deep at the centre, peak ~3 cm). Volume ≈ 95 x 2 = 190 ml x 1.0 = 190 g.
- Mushrooms (whole cooked button, about 8 pieces visible): about 6% of the plate, roughly 30 cm², about 1.5 cm thick. Volume ≈ 45 ml x 0.6 = 27 g. Mushrooms are mostly water, so bulk density 0.6 is used.
- Brussels sprouts and potato wedges (roast potatoes, yellow): together about 17% of the plate, roughly 90 cm², about 2 cm average thickness. Volume ≈ 180 ml. Split roughly 40% potato (about 72 ml x 0.8 ≈ 58 g... using 1.0 for mash-like density gives 72 g) and 60% sprouts/vegetable (about 108 ml x 0.6 ≈ 65 g). Potato ≈ 75 g; sprouts ≈ 65 g.
- White rice (cooked): about 22% of the plate, roughly 115 cm², mound about 2.5 cm average (peak ~4 cm). Volume ≈ 115 x 2.5 = 290 ml x 0.8 = 230 g.
- Pizza (cheese, tomato, thin crust): one slice, about 1/8 of a 30 cm pizza, roughly 75 g based on the slice size (about 12 x 9 cm footprint, 1.5 cm thick, dense cheese and crust). Use 80 g.

STEP 4 - Hidden food: the rice and chicken sit on a plate with no clear hidden base layer. No extra items added. Total ≈ 190 + 27 + 75 + 65 + 230 + 80 ≈ 667 g.

STEP 5 - kcal per 100 g (as served, cooked):
- Chicken breast, cooked: about 165 kcal per 100 g.
- Mushrooms, cooked: about 30 kcal per 100 g (sautéed with oil, so a bit higher; use 35).
- Potato, roasted: about 120 kcal per 100 g.
- Brussels sprouts, cooked: about 40 kcal per 100 g.
- White rice, cooked: about 130 kcal per 100 g.
- Pizza slice (cheese): about 270 kcal per 100 g.
